tables.identities: family/series nodes with kind, label, manufacturer_id, authority, status
tables.relationships: membership edges (parent_id -> child_id, rel_type='contains') carrying status, authority, source_sha256, source_locator, norm_rule, confidence, conflict_status
tables.meta: approval:<identity_id> rows written by identity.promote() — the owner approval reference that authorized each verified node

authority.verified_is_only_reachable_via: harness/search/identity.py::promote(con, identity_id, approval=...) — it requires a non-empty approval reference and records it in meta

approval_references.decision_text_sample: Approve OptiMOS, CoolMOS, CoolSiC, and StrongIRFET FACET-03 membership packets at commit 961ef951. Approval covers exactly the 626 proposed memberships represented by the pinned packet hashes and no additional candidates. Evidence standard is manufacturer-source, byte-verified PDF provenance with page and verbatim family attribution. Independent risk-stratified review: 77/77 supported, 0 unsupported, 0 evidence errors. Known series-level incompleteness is deferred to v2 and does not invalidate family membership.

serving_path.family_membership: harness/search/cohort.py::_attach_families — SELECT r.child_id, r.status, r.conflict_status, r.authority, r.source_sha256, r.source_locator, i.identity_id, i.label FROM relationships r JOIN identities i ... WHERE r.rel_type='contains' AND i.kind='family'; matches child_id 'opn:<OPN>'; grants family_id only for a single non-conflicting membership; statuses travel with every membership and are never upgraded
serving_path.m4_candidate_identity: harness/search/identity.py::build_identity_snapshot — canonical ids, grain, parents with authority and membership evidence; recorded per session as releases.m5_identity_snapshot (content-addressed, idempotent)
serving_path.never_read_for_family: catalog.parts.family is selected by cohort.build_cohort but is not used to construct a Candidate; the discovery path has no catalog family dependency
serving_path.disclosed_in_response: cohort notes state the catalog gap (family/mpn_base empty in catalog 0/1882, family-grain not fabricated) and the membership counts with statuses

materialization.rationale: parts.family is not the serving authority for DISCOVERY-01, so it was deliberately NOT populated to close a blocker; materializing it would duplicate identity and create a second source of truth
materialization.index_family_gap: indexer.family_units() builds family-grain units from catalog.parts.family, so the SEARCH surface has 1,882 family-grain units with empty family labels and 0 units carrying a family value; the DISCOVERY surface does not read units.family
materialization.materializing_the_index_would_change: the search index release fingerprint (units content), so it requires explicit owner authorization and a re-prime of the policy release cache

reproducibility.this_branch_identity_api: add_relationship refuses status='verified' and promote() updates identities only, so this branch can neither fabricate nor reproduce the live verified relationship state
reproducibility.implication: the live store is authoritative and the serving path reads it faithfully, but the tooling that produced that state lives on the facet-03 / facet-decision lanes; production promotion must run from a branch that contains those commits, or they must be merged with owner authorization
reproducibility.verification_performed: counts, statuses and approval refs were read directly from the live store by this script and are locked by tests/test_discovery01_b1_identity_authority.py
